notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Flamecache Gecko that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Flamecache Gecko token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Flamecache Gecko token's trigger, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
